articles.title: Bronny James makes his case with extra work as he battles to keep his Lakers spot
articles.standfirst: With LeBron James no longer in Los Angeles, Bronny has a chance to prove he belongs on his own
articles.summary: With LeBron James no longer in Los Angeles, Bronny has a chance to prove he belongs on his own
articles.body:
For many, now more than ever, Bronny James has the perfect opportunity to prove that he deserves a place on the Lakers roster with his father no longer part of the organization. ​ ​Since Bronny arrived in Los Angeles, fans and media have repeatedly questioned whether his place on one of the NBA’s biggest franchises was earned through his talent or simply because he is LeBron James’ son. His seasons have not been particularly outstanding, giving more fuel to those discussions.

Bronny is focused on making his own case

The comments have been relentless, but Bronny wants to show that his place with the Lakers can be earned on his own merits . The young guard is a talented athlete, and while the pressure surrounding his situation has followed him, he is now showing signs of the work and effort needed to make an impression.

A video from the Lakers’ first day of training offered another look at that approach. James turned heads with his defensive intensity and shooting accuracy , while additional footage showed him going after his teammates with plenty of effort on defense . He was also the last player to leave the Lakers’ El Segundo facility after practice.

The Lakers still have a decision to make

If James continues to impress during training camp, he is likely to make the final Lakers roster for the 2026-27 season. There had already been speculation that the Lakers could waive one of Bronny, Jaden Hardy or Dalton Knecht as they look to trim the roster from 16 players to 15.

The Lakers are expected to make their final roster decision at some point during the preseason , leaving Bronny with an opportunity to continue making his case before that call is made.

He also made it clear on Media Day that he wants to step out of his father’s shadow. With LeBron no longer beside him in the Lakers locker room , Bronny now has the chance to show what he can do without his dad as his teammate.

articles.title: Luka Doncic and the Lakers get encouraging news from JJ Redick ahead of the new NBA season
articles.standfirst: The Lakers are beginning the new Doncic era with a new owner and without LeBron James
articles.summary: The Lakers are beginning the new Doncic era with a new owner and without LeBron James
articles.body:
The Los Angeles Lakers are entering a brave new era for the 2026–27 NBA season , marked by a radical offseason overhaul that has completely reshaped the franchise.

For the first time in nearly a decade, the purple and gold will take the floor without LeBron James , whose eight-year tenure brought a championship to Los Angeles. Under fresh ownership and a heavily reconstructed roster, head coach JJ Redick faces the monumental task of steering a group that looks entirely different from last year's squad.

Amidst all the roster turnover, the Lakers' championship ambitions remain anchored by their unmistakable star power in Luka Dončić . The scoring champion from last season returns as the undisputed cornerstone of the franchise, flanked once again by his trusted backcourt partner, Austin Reaves .

Coach Redick will rely heavily on this dynamic duo to foster chemistry with a wave of new arrivals as the Lakers brace for a grueling campaign in a hyper-competitive Western Conference , where heavyweight powerhouses like the Spurs , Nuggets , Thunder, Rockets , and Timberwolves all stand in their way.

JJ Redick Delivers Positive Health Updates as Lakers Open Training Camp

The Los Angeles squad officially commenced training camp ahead of the upcoming NBA preseason , which kicks off on October 5 against the Sacramento Kings.

Speaking to reporters following the opening session, head coach JJ Redick delivered highly encouraging news regarding the roster's overall physical condition.

Fortunately for Los Angeles, camp opened completely free of major health restrictions, with Redick confirming that “ Everybody participated ” in the workout.

While a select few individuals are being managed and are not yet cleared for full-contact drills , they are expected to be fully integrated later in the week, leaving the coaching staff with zero health concerns as preparations accelerate.

Chemistry, Roster Goals, and the Road Ahead for Los Angeles

Managing player wellness is a massive relief for the franchise given how severely injuries derailed key contributors last season, most notably Luka Dončić , Austin Reaves , and new frontcourt anchor Walker Kessler .

Ensuring this vital trio remains healthy and synchronized is Redick's top priority ahead of the regular-season opener on October 21 against the Golden State Warriors .

To build early cohesion with so many new faces, Dončić notably organized a team trip to his native Slovenia during the offseason, uniting the group for an intensive training block.

Redick now faces the intricate puzzle of determining his optimal starting five alongside Dončić, Reaves, and Kessler, while shaping a reliable rotation capable of meeting championship expectations in Los Angeles .

NBA Preseason 2026 schedule: Dates, times and where to watch every game. The NBA returns on October 3 with nearly two weeks of preseason basketball, including games in Canada, Hawaii, Las Vegas and Macau. ESPN will carry five nationally televised matchups before the 2026-27 regular season begins on October 21.

The NBA preseason is almost here, with teams preparing for the final stretch of roster decisions, rotation experiments and tune-up games before the regular season begins.

The schedule opens Saturday, October 3, when the Miami Heat face the Toronto Raptors in Quebec City, before expanding into a packed slate that runs through October 16.

ESPN has confirmed five national broadcasts across ESPN and ESPN2, beginning October 8 with the Sacramento Kings visiting the Los Angeles Lakers . All five ESPN games will also be available through the ESPN App.

ESPN’s nationally televised NBA preseason games

The first national game arrives Thursday, October 8, when Sacramento visits the Lakers at 10:30 p.m. ET on ESPN2.

articles.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo’s new Miami Heat teammate stunned by one aspect of his game: “It’s insane”
articles.standfirst: Giannis is already impressing his new teammates in South Florida with his jaw-dropping talent and skills.
articles.summary: Giannis is already impressing his new teammates in South Florida with his jaw-dropping talent and skills.
articles.body:
It’s an exciting time to be a Miami Heat fan. After three straight seasons of average performances in the Eastern Conference , the front office shook things up this season by acquiring Giannis Antetokounmpo .

Giannis will bring something completely different, especially on offense, to a team that has been begging for a true superstar on that side of the ball. While it will take time for him to acclimate to his new teammates, one of them has already noticed the immense skills and talent Giannis brings to the table - with one of those skills really standing out.

Nikola Jovic shocked by Giannis Antetokounmpo's passing ability

While appearing on a local Heat podcast, fifth-year forward Nikola Jovic explained what has stood out to him about Giannis so far during their time together on the basketball court: his passing ability .

He can pass the s**t out of the ball. It’s insane. Sometimes he’ll pass it in the right spot but you’re not there and it’s like, ‘ahh f**k, I gotta get to the right spot.’ You have this superstar that two guys have to guard every time and he still finds you right away in the perfect spot. We played pickup yesterday and Pelle [Larsson] had six wide open dunks. It’s insane how good his court vision is.

The player Giannis is replacing, at least in terms of carrying the offensive load, is Tyler Herro . Herro was more of a pure shooter and scorer than playmaker, so Antetokounmpo is bringing something totally different to the table than Heat players have seen in recent seasons .

articles.title: Victor Wembanyama takes not-so-subtle shot at LeBron James and other NBA stars for compromising their morals
articles.standfirst: Wemby continues to endear himself to basketball fans from every walk of life.
articles.summary: Wemby continues to endear himself to basketball fans from every walk of life.
articles.body:
Three years into his NBA career, Victor Wembanyama has been every bit as good as advertised. “Wemby” was a teenage prodigy, going viral on social media due to his incredible highlights at such a young age, while towering over everyone with his long and lanky frame.

Already a two-time All-Star and having led the San Antonio Spurs to the NBA Finals last season, there appears to be no ceiling for Wembanyama’s greatness. But aside from his otherworldly talent, it’s been his off-court persona that has truly endeared him to fans.

Victor Wembanyama says he would never work with a sports gambling company

From speaking out on injustices in the world to spending zen time with monks, Wembanyama has turned into one of the most interesting professional athletes in the world. He’s at inner peace with who he has become, and he’s unwilling to sell his soul for profit .

So it was no surprise to hear Wembanyama completely shut down the idea of potentially partnering with a sports gambling company .

Absolutely not, I will never do that. Honestly, I think it’s very sad to see some players promote it, in my opinion. Everybody does whatever they want, but without me… I refused plenty, much more money than I’ve made, for things that were not to my values. Now I want to promote things that have a good impact, have a good influence in the world… One thing that’s very important for me: Our biggest strength is not our [money] - obviously we earn millions and millions - it’s not our biggest strength. Our biggest strength is inspiring, and we can inspire in a good or bad way. I want to inspire in a good way, that’s the strongest thing I can do.

Wembanyama’s answer is notable because it comes with a not-so-subtle shot at LeBron James . James had a longstanding partnership with DraftKings , before announcing recently that he’s now an ambassador Polymarket . James’ decision didn’t sit well with fans, and it seems like it didn’t sit well with Wembanyama either.

As Wemby mentions, there are plenty of other professional athletes who have done the same as James. But The King has a very wide reach, and Wembanyama believes that should be used for better causes.

articles.title: Jalen Duren swallows 200 million and his aversion to the scale: the All-Star center stays with the Pistons
articles.standfirst: Jalen Duren, who was eligible for a maximum of 287 million over five years, accepts the 200 million over 5 years that the Pistons offered him and that he turned down two weeks ago
articles.summary: Jalen Duren, who was eligible for a maximum of 287 million over five years, accepts the 200 million over 5 years that the Pistons offered him and that he turned down two weeks ago
articles.body:
J alen Duren agreed to a fully guaranteed five-year, $200 million contract to return to the Detroit Pistons , according to his agent Chafie Fields , who told ESPN 's Shams Charania .

The 22-year-old player, who did not report to preseason training or the Pistons' Media Day , thus put an end to a salary dispute that had dragged on for four months and in which he was in line for a five-year, $287 million maximum multiyear contract.

Duren, who was a restricted free agent and was an All-Star in 2026, had turned down the team's offer of 5 years and 200 million two weeks earlier .

Had he not accepted the proposal, he would have had to settle for a qualifying offer of 1 year and 9.6 million, which would have made him an unrestricted free agent next summer.

Jalen Duren felt underestimated by the Pistons

Sources informed Charania earlier this week that his representatives made it clear that the player felt slighted by the process, especially compared with the team's handling of forward Ausar Thompson's contract extension, who agreed earlier this month to a five-year, $155 million contract under the rookie scale.

Duren, who last season averaged 19.5 points and 10.5 rebounds while shooting 65% , also expressed his disagreement with the weight-related clauses included in some of the team's previous offers.

articles.title: Who is Braiden Bell? The broadcaster fired by the Trail Blazers for controversial racist and misogynistic posts
articles.standfirst: The 29-year-old broadcaster had been preparing for his first NBA play-by-play role before old social media posts emerged
articles.summary: The 29-year-old broadcaster had been preparing for his first NBA play-by-play role before old social media posts emerged
articles.body:
B raiden Bell ’s first NBA broadcasting job ended before he ever called a game.

The Trail Blazers fired the 29-year-old broadcaster Thursday night, roughly eight hours after announcing his hiring, after social media posts Bell made as a teenager in 2012 and 2013 resurfaced.

The posts included derogatory comments about Asian people and women. One December 2012 post read, “I’m not racist at all.. But not gonna lie.. Asian people piss me off! Hahaha #Honest,” while other posts contained misogynistic language.

Portland acted quickly after the posts were brought to the organization’s attention.

“The Portland Trail Blazers have zero tolerance for racist, sexist, or harmful comments,” the team said in a statement.

“Social media posts made by our recently announced play-by-play broadcaster are in clear violation of team and league policies, as well as our values and expectations.”

Bell was rising broadcasting talent

Before the controversy, Bell ’s career had been moving steadily upward. He graduated from Arizona State University in 2019 and worked college games for Cal Baptist and Arizona State on ESPN+.

He later moved into professional basketball, calling games for the Phoenix Suns’ G League affiliate and the WNBA’s Phoenix Mercury .

Portland selected Bell after an extensive search to replace longtime broadcaster Kevin Calabro , who left the organization after the sides failed to agree on a new contract.

Bell reportedly impressed the Trail Blazers with his on-air presence, chemistry with analyst Lamar Hurd and potential for growth. The final choice had come down to Bell and Kyle Draper , who previously worked games for the Sacramento Kings .

The job would have represented Bell’s first full-time NBA play-by-play opportunity.

Trail Blazers failed their own standard

The team’s statement went beyond condemning Bell ’s past posts. Portland also accepted responsibility for not identifying them before announcing the hire.

“The play-by-play role carries a long legacy of excellence, on the broadcast and in character, and we hold that standard without exception,” the Blazers said. “We did not meet our own bar in this process, and for that we apologize to Blazers fans and to Rip City.”

The organization added that it wanted everyone connected to Rip City to feel “welcome and safe” and promised to do better when selecting its next broadcaster.

The reporting included in the source material noted that no offensive posts from Bell ’s adult years had been identified. Bell had also not publicly responded to his firing.

Portland must now decide whether to return to Draper or reopen the search entirely.

Bell , meanwhile, went from being introduced as the new voice of the Trail Blazers to losing the role before his first broadcast, all in the space of one day.

articles.title: Dennis Rodman’s alleged North Korea hotel meltdown resurfaces as Trump brings him back into the spotlight
articles.standfirst: A disturbing 2014 allegation follows the Bulls legend, but his later return complicates claims that he is no longer welcome
articles.summary: A disturbing 2014 allegation follows the Bulls legend, but his later return complicates claims that he is no longer welcome
articles.body:
Dennis Rodman once helped Michael Jordan win championships. Years later, his unlikely friendship with Kim Jong Un gave him access to a world few Americans ever see. Now, his appearance alongside President Donald Trump has brought renewed attention to an alleged hotel incident that supposedly put that relationship at risk.

Rodman joined Trump in Texas on October 1, where the president highlighted the former NBA star’s connection to North Korea’s leader. Reuters reported that Trump has expressed interest in meeting Kim again, although Rodman’s appearance did not establish that a new North Korea trip had been arranged.

What the North Korea hotel report actually claimed

The allegation dates to February 2014. The Korea Times, citing an unnamed source through Free North Korea Radio, reported that Rodman became heavily intoxicated at Pyongyang’s Koryo Hotel, allegedly vomiting, urinating and defecating in a hallway.

The source claimed authorities warned him that he would not be welcome back without completing treatment for alcohol abuse. The account remains an attributed allegation, rather than an independently established description of what happened.

Rodman returned in June 2017. Associated Press reporting documented his arrival and reception by a North Korean sports official. That visit does not establish the current state of his relationship with Kim.

For basketball fans, Rodman’s unpredictability was familiar long before those trips. He won three championships alongside Jordan with the Chicago Bulls , bringing relentless rebounding and defense to their second three-peat.

The Last Dance also revisited his midseason Las Vegas break, illustrating the unusual balancing act surrounding a teammate whose contribution on the court was essential.

That combination of sporting greatness and unpredictable behavior helps explain why Rodman still draws attention. His North Korea connection is real, and the hotel allegation has a traceable source.

What the available reporting does not establish is that Kim ended their friendship over it or that Rodman is unwelcome today.

articles.title: When does the NBA Season 2026 starts? Date, time and TV channel for the first game of the season
articles.standfirst: The 2026-27 NBA campaign begins with a three-game opening night on October 20
articles.summary: The 2026-27 NBA campaign begins with a three-game opening night on October 20
articles.body:
Basketball fans will not have to wait much longer for the return of the NBA , with the 2026-27 regular season officially beginning on Tuesday, October 20, 2026.

The league will open the campaign with three nationally televised games, giving supporters an immediate look at several of the teams expected to attract attention throughout the season.

According to the NBA's official key dates, the regular season begins with the Boston Celtics visiting the Detroit Pistons at 3 p.m. ET, followed by the Philadelphia 76ers facing the defending champion New York Knicks at 7 p.m. ET.

The opening-night tripleheader concludes with the Oklahoma City Thunder traveling to face the San Antonio Spurs at 9:30 p.m. ET.

For viewers in the United Kingdom, the first game is particularly convenient by NBA standards. Boston's visit to Detroit tips off at 8 p.m. BST, meaning fans do not need to stay up into the early hours to watch the opening contest of the new season.

The Celtics-Pistons matchup will be broadcast nationally in the United States on NBC and Peacock. The second and third games of the night will also be available through NBC/Peacock, creating a full evening of NBA action.

What to expect on NBA opening night

The first game has been deliberately scheduled as an afternoon contest, with Boston traveling to Detroit after the two teams recorded the Eastern Conference's best regular-season records in 2025-26.

It will therefore provide an early test for two teams entering the new campaign with significant expectations.

The second game could prove to be the centerpiece of the opening-night schedule. The 76ers at Knicks matchup will take place at Madison Square Garden, where New York will raise its championship banner after winning the 2025-26 NBA title.

The game also marks a major moment for Philadelphia, with LeBron James and Jaylen Brown making their Philadelphia debuts.

The night then moves west for a rematch between the Oklahoma City Thunder and San Antonio Spurs . The teams meet again after their seven-game Western Conference Finals series in 2026, giving the final game of opening night an immediate postseason storyline.

The league's new season will also feature several changes to the television landscape. NBC and Peacock are taking on a major portion of the NBA's national coverage, while ESPN and ABC remain part of the league's broadcast lineup and Prime Video continues its NBA coverage.

The NBA has confirmed that national games are available through the corresponding streaming services, including Peacock for NBCUniversal games, ESPN App for ABC/ESPN games and Prime Video for Amazon's schedule.

Opening night is only the beginning of a packed first week. On Wednesday, October 21, ESPN will show the Minnesota Timberwolves against the Miami Heat at 7:30 p.m. ET before the Golden State Warriors visit the Los Angeles Lakers at 10 p.m. ET.

The following night brings Cleveland against Philadelphia and Denver against Oklahoma City.

The 2026-27 regular season will eventually run through April 11, 2027, when all 30 teams are scheduled to be in action. Before then, fans will also have the Emirates NBA Cup, Christmas Day games, NBA All-Star 2027 in Phoenix and the later postseason to look forward to.

For fans simply asking when they can watch the first meaningful NBA game of the new campaign, the answer is clear: Tuesday, October 20, with Celtics vs. Pistons at 3 p.m. ET, or 8 p.m. BST in the UK, live on NBC and Peacock in the United States.

articles.title: LeBron James just changed the Sixers' championship outlook and the NBA is in trouble
articles.standfirst: Philadelphia went from an outsider to one of the teams expected to be in the title conversation
articles.summary: Philadelphia went from an outsider to one of the teams expected to be in the title conversation
articles.body:
P hiladelphia did not need much convincing that its offseason was different. The 76ers had already made one of the NBA's biggest moves by acquiring Jaylen Brown from the Boston Celtics. Then they landed LeBron James . The result was immediate: Philadelphia's odds to win the 2027 NBA championship surged to +900, putting the Sixers alongside the defending champion New York Knicks for the third-shortest odds on the board, behind the Oklahoma City Thunder and San Antonio Spurs at +270. The latest DraftKings-based odds still have Philadelphia at +900 as of Oct. 1.

The transformation has been remarkable. Philadelphia was priced at 60-1 after the offseason began. The acquisition of Brown moved the Sixers to 20-1, and the addition of James produced another dramatic jump, ultimately bringing the team to +900. In a matter of months, Philadelphia went from an outsider to one of the teams expected to be in the championship conversation.

LeBron changes the equation in Philadelphia

The Sixers' case was already intriguing before James arrived. Brown gives Philadelphia another proven two-way star alongside Joel Embiid and Tyrese Maxey . The arrival of James, however, changes how those pieces can fit together.

The projected core features J ames, Brown, Embiid, Maxey and young guard VJ Edgecombe, giving Philadelphia a combination of established stars, scoring, size, playmaking and perimeter athleticism. James' decision also gives the Sixers another elite passer who can create opportunities for Embiid and Brown while taking some of the offensive burden away from Maxey.

James, now 41, is entering his 24th NBA season. He will not be expected to carry Philadelphia the way he once carried Cleveland, Miami or Los Angeles. Instead, the Sixers can ask him to control stretches of games, create in the half court and help organize an offense that already has multiple players capable of creating their own shots.

That was part of the appeal for James . He said his relationship with Maxey and his desire to help Embiid win his first NBA championship were significant factors in his decision to sign with Philadelphia on a two-year, $8 million contract.

Philadelphia's rise has been one of the most dramatic movements of the NBA offseason. Before Brown arrived, the Sixers were sitting at a much longer price. Brown's arrival shortened those odds, and James' signing pushed them all the way to +900.

The move also altered Philadelphia's position in the Eastern Conference market. The Sixers went from +750 to +350 to win the East following the James news, putting them just behind New York at +330 in the market cited at the time.

The current market remains similarly bullish. Action Network's Oct. 1 board listed the Knicks at +340 and Philadelphia at +380 to win the Eastern Conference, while the Spurs and Thunder remained the co-favorites for the NBA championship at +270.

That distinction matters. The market isn't simply reacting to James' name. It is reacting to the possibility that his arrival completes a roster that already had significant star power. But +900 comes with plenty of questions

Talent is not the same thing as chemistry

Philadelphia has assembled a group with enormous individual credentials, but those players still have to figure out how to share the floor, distribute possessions and stay healthy over an 82-game season. Embiid remains the biggest variable.

When healthy, he gives Philadelphia a dominant interior presence. But his availability has been an ongoing concern, making his ability to stay on the court central to the Sixers' championship ambitions.

James also brings a different challenge because of his age and workload. Philadelphia does not need the version of James that averaged enormous minutes and carried an offense every night. It needs the version capable of maximizing the players around him while preserving enough of his game for the postseason.

articles.title: Bub Carrington admits to "tanking" to get the No. 1 pick in the Draft
articles.standfirst: He opens up about the overused strategy employed in the NBA, although it seems that in this case it will not be penalized
articles.summary: He opens up about the overused strategy employed in the NBA, although it seems that in this case it will not be penalized
articles.body:
There comes a point every season—if not throughout it—when some NBA teams do not offer their best version with the intention of losing games, finishing as low as possible in the standings, and having a better chance of selecting in the top spots of the draft the best young players who are coming up. "Tanking," as evident as it is difficult to prove.

However, there are times when someone lets something slip and reveals what was there for all to see but no one dared to confront. That happened to Bub Carrington, a Wizards player, whose team was the worst in the NBA last season with a 17-65 record. The 21-year-old acknowledged that they did everything possible to lose in hopes of landing promising AJ Dybantsa in the draft, which is ultimately what happened.

“Everyone was held back, in a way, simply because we were trying to land AJ Dybantsa. That’s no secret. But now, no. No one has handcuffs on. Everyone is free of ties,” said Carrington, who sees the team aiming for the title playoffs: "If you add the coaching staff and the veterans to that, we have a playoff team. That’s going to happen. If not now, then whenever it does."

Carrington's words could prompt an NBA investigation, as the league has recently shown great concern over "tanking," has considered measures to combat it, and has sanctioned some franchises. The Mavericks were fined $750,000 in 2023 after resting players in the final two games. In February of this year, the Jazz had to pay $500,000 for deliberately keeping key players on the bench. And it cost the Pacers $100,000 to misrepresent the availability of their players for a game.

However, journalist Sam Amick of "The Athletic" states that despite Carrington's admission, the Wizards are going to come out of this case unscathed. "According to a source, the NBA will not sanction the Wizards' point guard or the team for their candid comments about the strategy of losing on purpose," he wrote.

articles.title: NBA win total projections: Which teams are expected to win the most and the fewest games in 2026-27?
articles.standfirst: Six of the top 10 teams with the most projected wins are from the Eastern Conference, and four from the Western.
articles.summary: Six of the top 10 teams with the most projected wins are from the Eastern Conference, and four from the Western.
articles.body:
The 2026-27 NBA season starts in less than 20 days, and the first preseason game is already tonight in Quebec, with the Toronto Raptors hosting the Miami Heat . Both are expected to fight for a direct playoff spot in a stacked Eastern Conference after landing big veterans.

Miami now has two-time MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo . Toronto brought back Kawhi Leonard , who in his lone 2019 season there won the championship against the Warriors.

The Warriors are the other side of that story. Stephen Curry’s team is projected at 38.5 wins , among the worst 10 in the league, and a lot of that is two things.

They did not add a top player, and they will be without their second-best player, Jimmy Butler , until early 2027. The other is the West, where the two teams projected for the most wins in the league live.

Spurs and Thunder Lead NBA Win Total Projections Above 60

With the season this close, the win totals are out, the over/under the betting market is hanging on every team. Four of the higher marks sit in the West and six in the East, but the only two teams expected to clear 60 wins are both out West: the San Antonio Spurs and the Oklahoma City Thunder .

They had the two best records last season, met in the Western Conference finals , and open the year against each other on opening night.

Behind them, six teams are on the 50-win line or better . Three of them share the Atlantic : the champion New York Knicks at 53 , the Philadelphia 76ers at 52.5 and the Boston Celtics at 51 , a group that will see each other at least four times.

The Rockets (50.5) , Nuggets (50) and last year’s East No. 1 Pistons (50) are the other three in that range. The Nuggets number is one I would take. The Cavaliers and Raptors at 49.5 round out the top 10.

Kings, Nets and Bucks Sit at the Bottom of the 2026-27 Win Totals

The other end is the teams expected to take the hits. The Sacramento Kings lead that list at 23 wins , barely clearing 20. The Brooklyn Nets at 24.5 are the East team the market trusts least, then the Bucks at 28.5, who are going to feel Giannis leaving.

The new Clippers , without Leonard and with Brandon Ingram out for the first stretch, are projected at 29, one fewer than the Grizzlies , who complete that bottom five.

It is a long season and these are just the lines. They are still the cleanest read on who is supposed to be good, who is supposed to struggle, and which over/under is worth an argument before the first real tip.

articles.title: LeBron James was balling, babysitting and putting on a fantastic show in 76ers' debut at scrimmage
articles.summary: The 76ers' public address announcer ended a brief retirement over the summer in large part to get behind the mic and do what he did for the first time ahead of the team's annual scrimmage.
articles.body:
The 76ers' public address announcer ended a brief retirement over the summer in large part to get behind the mic and do what he did for the first time ahead of the team's annual scrimmage.

Matt Cord introduced LeBron James in the Sixers' starting lineup.

"At 6-9, from St. Vincent-St. Mary’s, No. 23, LeBron James! James!'

Close to 10,000 fans who plunked down $10 a ticket on Saturday to essentially witness a glorified practice at the Sixers’ home arena went wild for James' debut.

No, James didn't wear No. 23. He historically wore No. 6 over his career in practice gear but with that number retired in Philadelphia because of Julius Erving, James went with No. 9.

No, the dunks and 3s and assists didn't count in any official capacity. And no, James wasn't even introduced last. That honor remained reserved for Joel Embiid.

What the new 41-year-old on the block did do was give — along with Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, Jaylen Brown and VJ Edgecombe — a sneak preview that maybe, just maybe, the long underperforming Sixers might finally rise to the moment this season and meet their championship expectations.

“It was a great first step in a direction we're trying to go,” James said. “It was great to hear some cheers from our fans.”

Sixers fans that crammed aisles and stairways trying to catch a first glimpse or a snapshot of James were shooed back to their seats. Vendors hawked James merchandise outside the arena and told fans they could own the first pieces of his merchandise. Sixers fans that inched near the court screamed and outright begged James to stop and turnaround and pose for pictures. They also crammed into team stores buying No. 23 jerseys.

The Sixers started the scrimmage early with what they hope is a familiar sight: Maxey in transition hit James for an alley-oop dunk. James hung and swung on the rim for a few seconds.

James made a nifty behind-the-back pass to Edgecombe (who missed a corner 3) and even squared up and buried a long 3 from about Caitlin Clark range.

James did it all — he even bounced Maxey's baby daughter, Marvel, on his knee for a moment on the bench.

No word yet on James' hourly babysitting rate.

Not a bad first week in Philadelphia for the NBA’s career scoring leader.

“Everybody's been super welcoming,” James said. “I've been able to implement some things with my voice and just my command of how I play the game and my experience playing the game. I'm still getting more and more comfortable off the floor, with travel and without my family and things of that nature. That's going to be a little bit of a challenge, but everything's been good so far. Great first week."

The Sixers traditionally hold the scrimmage in Delaware on the home court of their G League team. The Sixers donated 5,000 tickets to local community groups and Sixers Youth Foundation grantee partners and more than $80,000 was raised for the Sixers Youth Foundation.

The $10 tickets were a deal. They are hovering around $1,000 a ticket for the 100 level on the secondary market for the Sixers' Oct. 22 home opener against Cleveland.

James was expected to play Monday in the first of four preseason games and mark the start of his record 24th NBA season.

“It’d be good to get out there with some of our guys to just get a rhythm," James said. “At the same time, also not overdo it. We're putting a lot into our practices right now. We're fine-tuning what we want to do once the game comes. I think there will be opportunities once we get out there in the preseason."

Philadelphia opens the season Oct. 20 in New York against the NBA champion Knicks.

James and the rest of the Sixers were encouraged that the oft-injured Embiid has been a full participant in camp and seems to be in leaner, lighter shape. Embiid pulled off a driving left-handed dunk in the scrimmage and later joked; it was “probably the last dunk of my career.”

Jerseys flew off the racks, Sixers flew through the air, and excitement swirled around the team and for all that James brings to the city.

“They've welcomed me with open arms,” James said, “and I'm getting more and more comfortable every day.”

articles.title: LeBron James has his hands full with Tyrese Maxey’s tiniest courtside guest
articles.standfirst: Maxey brought his daughter Marvel to the Sixers’ open scrimmage, where LeBron shared a moment that connects two different stages of fatherhood
articles.summary: Maxey brought his daughter Marvel to the Sixers’ open scrimmage, where LeBron shared a moment that connects two different stages of fatherhood
articles.body:
T yrese Maxey lifted his daughter Marvel during Philadelphia’s Blue x White Scrimmage, giving the afternoon a moment that had little to do with the score. The NBA posted the clip with the caption “Dad duties.” For the Sixers guard, basketball and fatherhood briefly shared the same space.

LeBron James joined that family scene, spending time with Marvel on the bench. Fans circulating the footage jokingly described him as her babysitter. The interaction offered a quieter glimpse of James during an event otherwise focused on what Philadelphia’s players could do on the court.

LeBron knows how quickly those courtside years pass

James is a father to Bronny, Bryce and Zhuri, and his family has long been part of his basketball life. The connection eventually reached an extraordinary milestone: on October 22, 2024, he and Bronny became the first father and son to play together in an NBA game. The family watched as a childhood connection to basketball became a professional one.

Maxey is near the beginning of that experience. He announced Marvel’s arrival earlier this year, adding fatherhood to a life already built around the demands of an NBA career . Bringing her to the scrimmage allowed him to share that world with her, even before she can understand the crowd, the uniforms or her father’s place on the team.

The Blue x White Scrimmage took place October 3 at Xfinity Mobile Arena. Philadelphia divided its roster into two teams for the annual event, giving supporters an early look at the group before the season. James and Maxey played together on the Blue team, then shared a different kind of moment away from the action.

For Maxey, these are the first months of bringing his child into his basketball life. For James, that journey has already included sharing an NBA court with his son.

Their interaction with Marvel put those two experiences side by side: a new father enjoying the beginning and a veteran father who knows how much can happen between a baby’s first visit and a grown child’s first game.

articles.title: LeBron James’ alley-oop at 41 gives Sixers fans a glimpse of what Maxey helped bring to Philly
articles.standfirst: A familiar finish in a new uniform gave Philadelphia fans an early look at the connection between James and Tyrese Maxey
articles.summary: A familiar finish in a new uniform gave Philadelphia fans an early look at the connection between James and Tyrese Maxey
articles.body:
T yrese Maxey sent the ball toward the rim, and LeBron James took care of the rest. The 41-year-old elevated for an alley-oop dunk during Philadelphia’s Blue x White Scrimmage on October 3, giving Sixers fans the kind of finish they have watched him deliver for more than two decades. This time, they were cheering for him in their own team’s colors.

The play unfolded in transition, with Maxey finding James for an emphatic finish. Ahead of his 24th NBA season, LeBron offered a brief reminder that he can still turn a well-timed pass into a highlight above the rim. It also gave Philadelphia an encouraging glimpse of how its two playmakers can work together.

Maxey gives LeBron another reason to enjoy his Philadelphia chapter

Their connection helped bring James to the Sixers in the first place. At his introductory press conference, LeBron identified Maxey as one of the main factors behind his decision to join Philadelphia.

The scrimmage put that relationship into motion: a player who helped recruit him was now setting him up in front of his new home crowd.

James and Maxey played on the Blue team alongside Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown and VJ Edgecombe . The annual event at Xfinity Mobile Arena gave supporters an early opportunity to see that group share the floor.

Their challenge now is to turn those promising sequences into dependable basketball when the season begins.

LeBron’s arrival carries clear championship ambitions. The four-time NBA champion said he believes Philadelphia can win the title, beginning another chapter after eight seasons with the Los Angeles Lakers. With his 42nd birthday approaching in December, he is preparing for a season that will extend his already extraordinary NBA career.

articles.title: Will the Air Jordan 1 High OG “Royal” Be worth buying?
articles.standfirst: The iconic colorway returns in October with leather, details inspired by 1985 and a construction that brings back part of its original essence.
articles.summary: The iconic colorway returns in October with leather, details inspired by 1985 and a construction that brings back part of its original essence.
articles.body:
October brings one of the sneaker releases that fans have been looking forward to the most: the 2026 Air Jordan 1 High OG “Royal.” The model returns with the classic black and Game Royal combination, but this time there is one detail that could make all the difference for those who have been waiting years for a version closer to the original: leather is back in the spotlight.

What changes in the 2026 Air Jordan 1 “Royal”?

The 2026 edition uses smooth leather in black and Game Royal, moving away from the all-suede construction of the 2023 Royal Reimagine d.

It also brings back the High OG silhouette, with a high cut, a straighter ankle shape and a slightly more streamlined toe box. The design keeps the “Nike Air” woven label on the tongue, the Wings logo on the ankle and the blue rubber outsole with its classic circular traction pattern.

The nod to the original Royals also appears in the presentation. The special box is inspired by Nike’s famous 1985 photograph known as “Flight Guy,” which shows Michael Jordan wearing the colorway, and includes interior paper designed as a tribute to the image.

Are they for playing basketball or everyday wear?

The Air Jordan 1 was born as a basketball sneaker, and some of its elements still reflect that origin. However, the model now also holds an important place in streetwear and everyday sneaker culture.

That is why the 2026 “Royal” is aimed at those looking for a pair that can complement casual outfits while still preserving the aesthetic of a basketball classic . Its combination of blue, black and white also keeps a distinctive look that is easy to recognize even off the court.

When are the 2026 Air Jordan 1 “Royal” releasing?

The release date is set for October 10, 2026 .

The sneakers will be available globally through the Nike SNKRS app and at select Jordan Brand retailers.

The 2026 Air Jordan 1 High OG “Royal” will retail for $185 USD .

articles.title: Jaylen Brown gets pranked and exposed by his own 76ers coworker: "Biggest narcissist in the league"
articles.standfirst: Brown isn't exactly universally liked among NBA fans.
articles.summary: Brown isn't exactly universally liked among NBA fans.
articles.body:
For whatever reason, Jaylen Brown seems to rub many people the wrong way. It's not just Boston Celtics fans who ended up despising him, especially when he angled his way out of the franchise. Casual NBA fans just aren't very fond of him.

Perhaps it's his confident personality, which makes him come across as "arrogant" to some. He certainly oozes an aura of assuredness within himself, which is great for him but annoying to fans. This week, we got another glimpse at that dichotomy.

The Philadelphia 76ers shared a video of the social media team pranking Sixers players with a 3-second guessing game. They showed the players a screenshot of the clock at exactly three seconds, which prompted the players to celebrate. Then it was revealed that they didn't actually get it right.

Brown's clip drew a lot of attention, as he went on an intellectual discourse while patting himself on the back: " It's timing. It's like, a diving thing, know what I mean? You gotta be connected. They're not connected like me. Right on the money ." Brown then laughed and looked dejected when told it was fake.

That didn't stop fans from piling on, with one saying " he felt tough [as hell] after saying that bulls**t " and another opining that Brown is " the biggest narcissist in the league ".

articles.title: The only free-agent decision that threatens to upset Steph Curry at Warriors' training camp
articles.standfirst: Seth Curry remains unsigned despite making clear he would welcome another season alongside his older brother
articles.summary: Seth Curry remains unsigned despite making clear he would welcome another season alongside his older brother
articles.body:
Stephen Curry has spent most of his career collecting milestones few players could imagine, but playing alongside his brother carried a different kind of significance.

That moment finally arrived last season when Seth Curry joined Golden State , only for injuries and limited availability to restrict their time together. Now Seth remains an unrestricted free agent, and there has been little indication the Warriors are preparing another reunion.

Seth made his preference clear during the offseason when asked whether he would consider returning.

“Absolutely,” he said. “I wasn’t able to do everything I wanted to do on the floor last year, but I always got a lot of love for the organization, the fans, first class.”

Golden State’s actions, however, suggest its priorities have shifted.

No time to enjoy being teammates

Seth joined the Warriors on a one-year, $2.77 million veteran-minimum contract and remained one of the league’s most efficient perimeter shooters during his limited opportunities.

He averaged 7.1 points in 10 appearances, shooting 49% overall and 48% from three-point range. His Warriors debut offered an immediate reminder of that shooting ability, with Seth scoring 14 points in 18 minutes on 6-of-7 shooting.

The family moment everyone had waited for took much longer. Seth ’s sciatica and Stephen ’s knee problems delayed their first appearance together until April. Golden State lost 117-116 to Houston that night, with Stephen scoring 29 points and Seth adding six.

Their partnership never had enough time to develop beyond that novelty. Seth logged only 133 regular-season minutes, and his health became a significant concern. He later revealed there was a month when his sciatic nerve problem was so severe that he “couldn’t move at all.”

Golden State focused on younger options

The Warriors have spent the offseason maintaining flexibility around Stephen rather than recreating last year’s roster.

Golden State retained De’Anthony Melton and Gary Payton II while adding Brandon Williams , with the organization also evaluating rookie Yaxel Lendeborg as part of a younger group. Stephen has publicly embraced that development process.

“The expectation for him is just keep getting better,” Curry said when discussing Lendeborg , emphasizing improvement over immediate statistical production. That approach makes Seth’s path back increasingly difficult.

The 36-year-old has built a 12-season career around elite shooting, hitting 43.3% of his three-pointers across 560 regular-season games. Yet Golden State ’s need for defensive versatility and younger depth may outweigh the sentimental appeal of keeping the brothers together.

A return cannot be ruled out completely. Seth was also outside the roster picture last year before rejoining the Warriors in November.

This time, however, Golden State appears comfortable waiting. leaving Stephen facing the possibility that his long-awaited partnership with his brother lasted only a handful of games.

That moment finally arrived last season when Seth Curry joined Golden State , only for injuries and limited availability to restrict their time together. Now Seth remains an unrestricted free agent, and there has been little indication the Warriors are preparing another reunion.
Seth made his preference clear during the offseason when asked whether he would consider returning.
“Absolutely,” he said. “I wasn’t able to do everything I wanted to do on the floor last year, but I always got a lot of love for the organization, the fans, first class.”
Golden State’s actions, however, suggest its priorities have shifted.
No time to enjoy being teammates
Seth joined the Warriors on a one-year, $2.77 million veteran-minimum contract and remained one of the league’s most efficient perimeter shooters during his limited opportunities.

He averaged 7.1 points in 10 appearances, shooting 49% overall and 48% from three-point range. His Warriors debut offered an immediate reminder of that shooting ability, with Seth scoring 14 points in 18 minutes on 6-of-7 shooting.

The family moment everyone had waited for took much longer. Seth ’s sciatica and Stephen ’s knee problems delayed their first appearance together until April. Golden State lost 117-116 to Houston that night, with Stephen scoring 29 points and Seth adding six.

Their partnership never had enough time to develop beyond that novelty. Seth logged only 133 regular-season minutes, and his health became a significant concern. He later revealed there was a month when his sciatic nerve problem was so severe that he “couldn’t move at all.”
Golden State focused on younger options
The Warriors have spent the offseason maintaining flexibility around Stephen rather than recreating last year’s roster.

Golden State retained De’Anthony Melton and Gary Payton II while adding Brandon Williams , with the organization also evaluating rookie Yaxel Lendeborg as part of a younger group. Stephen has publicly embraced that development process.

“The expectation for him is just keep getting better,” Curry said when discussing Lendeborg , emphasizing improvement over immediate statistical production. That approach makes Seth’s path back increasingly difficult.

The 36-year-old has built a 12-season career around elite shooting, hitting 43.3% of his three-pointers across 560 regular-season games. Yet Golden State ’s need for defensive versatility and younger depth may outweigh the sentimental appeal of keeping the brothers together.
A return cannot be ruled out completely. Seth was also outside the roster picture last year before rejoining the Warriors in November.
This time, however, Golden State appears comfortable waiting. leaving Stephen facing the possibility that his long-awaited partnership with his brother lasted only a handful of games.

articles.title: Lebron James dispels doubts about high-risk helicopter ride after first milestone with the 76ers
articles.standfirst: The 41-year-old is splitting time between Philadelphia and New York as he begins his 24th NBA season
articles.summary: The 41-year-old is splitting time between Philadelphia and New York as he begins his 24th NBA season
articles.body:
LeBron James has spent most of his career making difficult things look routine, and his latest adjustment appears to be no different.

After taking part in his first major scrimmage with the Philadelphia 76ers on Saturday, James left the arena and headed back toward New York by helicopter, reinforcing just how unusual his new setup is going to be during the 2026-27 season.

The scrimmage itself represented an important first step. Around 10,000 fans packed Xfinity Mobile Arena to see James with his new team, and the 41-year-old came away encouraged by what Philadelphia showed.

“To be able to take what we've done on the practice floor, bring it to a game floor situation around our fans... it was a great first step in the direction we're trying to go,” James said.

Then, rather than facing a long drive north, he took to the air.

James making unusual living arrangement work

James has said he plans to divide his time between Philadelphia and New York, creating a commute rarely seen around the NBA.

The distance between New York City and the Sixers ’ practice facility in Camden, New Jersey, is around 95 miles. By helicopter, the journey can be reduced to roughly 40 to 45 minutes.

That convenience could matter as James manages the demands of his 24th NBA season.

His decision to join Philadelphia came only after serious consideration of retirement. James admitted during the summer that he was close to walking away entirely.

“I thought I was done when the season ended,” he said. “I wasn't ready to announce it, and I knew I needed some time to really decide, but I was pretty sure I played my last game. I still truly love this game, and I have more to give.”

Real pressure will come on court

The helicopter commute may grab attention, but Philadelphia didn't bring James in for novelty value.

The Sixers have championship ambitions built around James, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey and Jaylen Brown , while James has made clear that winning remains central to his decision to keep playing.

He arrives after averaging 20.9 points, 7.2 assists and 6.1 rebounds across 60 games for the Lakers last season, showing that he can still provide major production even as workload management becomes increasingly important.

Philadelphia hasn't won an NBA championship since 1983, and adding James immediately raises expectations around the franchise. The opening schedule also adds a neat twist to his new living arrangement.

The Sixers begin preseason against the Knicks on October 5 and open the regular season at Madison Square Garden on October 20, bringing James straight into the city where he plans to spend part of the year.

articles.standfirst: Philadelphia opens the preseason against Knicks who start as favorites
articles.summary: Philadelphia opens the preseason against Knicks who start as favorites
articles.body:
The 2026 NBA Preseason warm-up campaign brings a heavyweight clash in the Eastern Conference: the Philadelphia 76ers host the New York Knicks in a matchup between two franchises aiming to battle for the top spots in the league once the regular season arrives.

Although October’s results do not count in the standings, these matchups serve to gauge rotations, fine-tune systems, and give minutes to young players looking to earn a spot on the roster. And few opponents offer as demanding a measuring stick as an Eastern Conference rivalry game.

Philadelphia 76ers vs New York Knicks: Time and where to watch it in the United States

The preseason matchup between Philadelphia and New York is scheduled for this Monday, October 5, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. (6:00 p.m. Central Time and 4:00 p.m. Pacific Time).

For those who enjoy the NBA starting from the preseason, NBA game broadcasts are handled by various networks and streaming services, in addition to the comprehensive NBA League Pass option for those who want to follow the entire preseason via streaming.

The tactical keys to follow in the NBA preseason game

In a warm-up matchup, attention shifts from the scoreboard to the details. It is worth paying attention to how Philadelphia distributes the minutes among its veteran pieces and the young group looking to establish itself: the three-point shooting percentage, the pace at which the team wants to run, and the defensive organization in the first quarters will say more than the final result.

On the Knicks’ side, the priority will be cohesion. A team that aspires to compete at the top of the East needs its half-court defense—traditionally one of its trademarks—to look sharp from the very first beat of October. Rebounding and controlling turnovers will be early indicators of where the New York roster stands.

Prediction for the 76ers vs Knicks: The favorite according to the market

Although the preseason usually blurs predictions, the betting market offers a clear snapshot of the relative weight of these two teams heading into the 2026-27 season. On the moneyline, the New York Knicks appear as favorites with an implied probability of 63.5% (odds of 1.53), compared to 36.5% for the Philadelphia 76ers (2.78).

The spread (points handicap) reinforces that hierarchy: New York starts with a margin ranging from -4.5 to -5.5 points, while Philadelphia gets those same points as an advantage by taking +4.5, +5, or +5.5.

As for the total points, sportsbooks have set the line around 231.5 points, with virtually identical odds for the over and the under (1.93 on both sides at that line), a sign of a game that bookmakers expect to be balanced in offensive pace.

It is worth remembering, however, that no preseason figure should be taken at face value: the absence of stars, minute agreements, and tactical experiments distort both the scoreboard and the winner. The Knicks’ favoritism reflects the stature of their roster, not a guaranteed result in an October game.

With the favorites tag and an implied probability close to 64%, the New York Knicks come in as the benchmark of the matchup according to the market. That said, the preseason is the realm of controlled randomness: whoever gives more minutes to their starters and finds offensive rhythm first will have the advantage.

The adjusted total of 231.5 suggests a closely matched scoring game, so a tight finish decided in the final minutes would not be surprising, with Philadelphia using its home-court advantage to fight the point margin. The most sensible read: Knicks slightly ahead, but a 76ers team capable of covering the spread at home.

Beyond the scoreboard, what matters in October is getting into shape. And for two franchises with ambitions in the East, there are few tests by fire as useful as facing each other before what really counts begins.

articles.standfirst: The preseason debut that pits Dončić against Sacramento's new artillery
articles.summary: The preseason debut that pits Dončić against Sacramento's new artillery
articles.body:
The season hasn't officially started yet, but the atmosphere at the Golden 1 Center is already electric. The Sacramento Kings host the Los Angeles Lakers in one of the most anticipated preseason matchups, a test between two California franchises arriving with revamped rosters, new pieces to integrate, and the need to find their rhythm before the real scoring begins.

Los Angeles Lakers vs Sacramento Kings: schedule and where to watch

The NBA preseason game between the Sacramento Kings and the Los Angeles Lakers is scheduled for Monday, October 5, 2026, at 10:00 pm Eastern Time (9:00 pm Central Time and 7:00 pm Pacific Time).

NBA coverage is spread across various networks and streaming services, in addition to the comprehensive NBA League Pass option for those who want to stream the entire preseason. For this game, you can watch it locally on NBA TV and Spectrum SportsNet.

Two California projects in the midst of identity reconstruction

Even though it's preseason —where the result matters little and rotations are everything—, this duel offers a first look at two squads that have made significant moves during the summer.

The Kings arrive with a high-voltage backcourt. Zach LaVine brings explosiveness and scoring ability from the perimeter, accompanied by Malik Monk, a point guard/shooting guard who already knows the team and can punish opponents from three-point range.

The team's core continues to revolve around Domantas Sabonis, the 30-year-old Lithuanian center who combines rebounding, passing, and a presence in the paint like few others in the league. Alongside him, Keegan Murray and De'Andre Hunter offer size, defense, and outside shooting at the small forward positions, while the addition of Ben Simmons gives Sacramento an unconventional playmaker and a versatile defender.

On the Los Angeles side, all eyes are on Luka Dončić. The 27-year-old Slovenian is the absolute engine of a Lakers team that has built its roster around him. Alongside him, Austin Reaves has solidified his role as the team's second playmaker, and the backcourt is bolstered by Collin Sexton and Quentin Grimes, two players who bring scoring and energy.

In the paint, the signing of Walker Kessler completely changes the Lakers' defensive approach: the 25-year-old center is one of the best shot blockers and rim protectors of his generation. The roster is rounded out by seasoned veterans like Kevon Looney and elite defenders such as Matisse Thybulle and Jarred Vanderbilt.

The key matchup: Sabonis versus Kessler

The battle inside promises to be the tactical chess match of the night. Sabonis, who operates as the nerve center of Sacramento's offense from the high post, will face off against Walker Kessler's rim protection.

The Lithuanian's ability to create scoring opportunities by passing the ball will clash with the Lakers' big man's shot-blocking instincts. How Sacramento resolves that matchup will say a lot about their offense heading into the regular season.

On the perimeter, the other major argument is the generational head-to-head: Dončić's veteran experience and creative talent versus the Kings' backcourt artillery led by LaVine and Monk.

In preseason, it is usual for stars to play limited minutes, so much of the spotlight will fall on the second units and on young players looking to earn a place.

What is the prediction for the Lakers vs Kings preseason game?

Preseason results rarely reflect true hierarchy, and with extensive rotations and carefully managed stars, everything points to an open, high-tempo game. The Kings' deep bench, with its strong backcourt and the stability of Sabonis, could tip the scales at home as the quarters progress, while the Lakers will likely prioritize experimenting with their new faces.

More than the score, what will capture everyone's attention is how the pieces mesh: the Sabonis-LaVine duo in Sacramento and the chemistry between Dončić and Kessler in Los Angeles. Whatever the outcome, this Californian duel is the perfect appetizer before the real action begins.

articles.body:
The 2026-27 NBA season gets underway in just two weeks, with the reigning champion New York Knicks attempting to become the first back-to-back titleholders in the league since the 2018 Golden State Warriors .

The Knicks open their defense at home inside Madison Square Garden against a revamped Philadelphia 76ers squad that made waves this offseason by adding superstar LeBron James alongside Jaylen Brown .

Both New York and Philadelphia enter the campaign sharing the highest win total projection in the Eastern Conference , setting the stage for what many anticipate will be a titanic playoff showdown next May, though a grueling 82-game schedule stands between now and then.

LeBron James Enters Year 24 with Chronic Foot and Back Concerns

Without question, there is no more intriguing storyline in professional basketball than LeBron James embarking on the final chapter of his storied career in Philadelphia.

Turning 42 years old this season, James is set to log a record 24th NBA season , having inked a two-year, $7,946,884 veteran-minimum contract with the ultimate goal of capturing his fifth, or even sixth, ring like Michael Jordan .

However, the immense physical toll accumulated over two decades is presenting new hurdles; according to a recent ESPN report , James is managing chronic arthritis in his left foot alongside lingering issues with sciatica in his lower back, which forced him to miss the first month of the previous season.

To combat these physical demands, James has established a rigorous daily routine at Sixers training camp , arriving before 8:00 AM to work alongside longtime athletic trainer Mike Mancias on targeted stretching and activation before team practice.

While head coach Nick Nurse plans to carefully manage his workload alongside co-stars Joel Embiid , Tyrese Maxey , and Jaylen Brown , James made it clear during Media Day that anything short of advancing past the conference semifinals will be deemed a failure for this franchise.

To combat these physical demands, James has established a rigorous daily routine at Sixers training camp , arriving before 8:00 AM to work alongside longtime athletic trainer Mike Mancias on targeted stretching and activation before team practice.

While head coach Nick Nurse plans to carefully manage his workload alongside co-stars Joel Embiid , Tyrese Maxey , and Jaylen Brown , James made it clear during Media Day that anything short of advancing past the conference semifinals will be deemed a failure for this franchise.

articles.title: Austin Reaves drops truth bomb on playing with Luka Doncic
articles.standfirst: Austin Reaves reveals the unexpected challenge of playing alongside Luka Doncic.
articles.summary: Austin Reaves reveals the unexpected challenge of playing alongside Luka Doncic.
articles.body:
With nine new faces and two starting spots still up for grabs, the Lakers opened training camp with several adjustments pending as they build their new identity. One of them is Austin Reaves ' adaptation to playing alongside Luka Doncic , a duo that will be key to Los Angeles' offensive future.

However, when asked about the biggest challenge of sharing the court with the Slovenian, Reaves surprised with an unexpected answer.

The challenge of playing with Luka Doncic

"The hardest part [about playing with Luka] is to understand his English on the court," Reaves said, via ESPN Los Angeles . "He gets talking fast, Slovenian, Serbian, speaks 4 languages. Sometimes I'm looking at him like, 'talk to me in English, I need English.'"

Although the comment came in a humorous tone, Reaves acknowledged that the speed with which Doncic communicates his ideas during games requires an adjustment process. It is one of many challenges facing a team that underwent a deep roster overhaul.

The Lakers bet on Doncic and Reaves

The duo of Doncic and Reaves will be the axis of the Lakers' offensive project. Both can create their own shots and generate opportunities for teammates, but the team's success will also depend on the rest of the roster's contributions in outside shooting and defense.

To strengthen that side, Los Angeles added defensive specialists. Reaves singled out Matisse Thybulle, Ziaire Williams, Adou Thiero and 7-foot-2 center Walker Kessler after facing them in the first practices.

"Defensively, we're going to be much better," Reaves said. The guard explained that the group competes on every possession and lets each player focus on fulfilling his role within the system.

That defensive improvement could help Doncic and Reaves come into the offense with more energy by reducing the burden of guarding the toughest matchups. At the same time, it raises the importance of the two spots still open in JJ Redick's starting lineup.

The Lakers still have important decisions to make before settling on their rotation. And according to Reaves , one of the first tasks will be learning to decipher Doncic ... even if it means asking him to explain it in English first.

articles.title: Dillon Brooks starts a brawl just minutes into his Suns preseason debut
articles.standfirst: Dillon Brooks wasted no time bringing his trademark intensity to Phoenix, but the Suns must make sure his edge doesn’t cross the line.
articles.summary: Dillon Brooks wasted no time bringing his trademark intensity to Phoenix, but the Suns must make sure his edge doesn’t cross the line.
articles.body:
D illon Brooks needed less than five minutes to remind everyone what comes with the package.

The Phoenix Suns forward was involved in a heated confrontation with John Collins , the Detroit Pistons ' newcomer, at the start of Monday's preseason opener at Little Caesars Arena. Collins ended up putting his hand on Brooks' neck. After a lengthy review, officials assessed Collins a Flagrant 1 foul and Brooks a technical.

The sequence began when the two collided battling for position near the rim. Collins grabbed an offensive rebound with 7:25 left in the first quarter, Brooks tried to knock the ball away and was called for a personal foul. Collins reacted immediately, got in Brooks ' face and put his hand around his neck as players and officials separated them.

Brooks' intensity, back in the spotlight

For anyone who watched Brooks last season, the scene wasn't surprising. His identity in the NBA is built on physical defense, constant trash talk and a willingness to make opponents uncomfortable, an intensity that has sometimes gotten out of hand. He led the league with 17 technical fouls last year and has been suspended six times in his career.

Phoenix knew what kind of player it was getting. It acquired him from Houston in the Kevin Durant trade, and Brooks averaged a career-high 20.2 points in 56 games and helped the Suns return to the playoffs. In August, the team rewarded him with a three-year, $73 million extension through the 2029-30 season. General manager Brian Gregory said at the time that his "toughness, competitiveness and work ethic" represent the Suns' identity.

The confrontation came just days after Brooks' legal situation returned to the headlines. He was arrested after a traffic stop on March 6 in Scottsdale while recovering from a fractured left hand. In late September, prosecutors filed a misdemeanor DUI charge , with a hearing scheduled for Oct. 28 .

He also faces separate misdemeanor charges of reckless driving and speeding stemming from a January arrest, with a hearing in November . The Suns said last week that they had already addressed the March matter with him and made no further comment.

Phoenix didn't give him $73 million so he would stop being Dillon Brooks : his physical, defiant style is part of what makes him valuable. But there is always a line that can't be crossed, and on Sunday it was Collins who crossed it.

The Suns need that intensity. They just need Brooks to keep it under control.

articles.title: Why the Thunder are the NBA’s No. 1 preseason favorite and built to beat anyone
articles.standfirst: They have continuity, defensive versatility and enough talent around their stars to create problems for the rest of the league
articles.summary: They have continuity, defensive versatility and enough talent around their stars to create problems for the rest of the league
articles.body:
The Oklahoma City Thunder enter the new NBA season with something every contender wants and very few teams can claim: a roster capable of answering almost any question a playoff opponent can ask. That's why the Thunder sit at No. 1 in the preseason rankings. Oklahoma City enters training camp as the clear favorite after falling to San Antonio in seven games last postseason, but the loss hasn't diminished the belief that this is still the team with perhaps the most complete championship formula in the NBA.

If anything, the defeat provided another lesson for a young team that already knows what it takes to win at the highest level. The Thunder have Shai Gilgeous-Alexander , the centerpiece of their offense. They have Chet Holmgren , whose health could determine just how high their ceiling goes.

They have continuity, defensive versatility and enough talent around their stars to create problems for virtually every type of opponent. And in a Western Conference that includes a rising Spurs team led by Victor Wembanyama, that's no small advantage.

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander gives OKC a playoff closer

The most obvious reason to believe in Oklahoma City starts with Gilgeous-Alexander. Playoff basketball eventually becomes a series of possessions in which somebody has to create a good shot when the offense breaks down. The Thunder have that player.

Gilgeous-Alexander gives Oklahoma City an elite isolation scorer who can attack the rim, create space in the midrange and punish defenses that switch or overcommit. His ability to control the tempo of a game also gives the Thunder something particularly valuable in the postseason: a player who doesn't need a perfect offensive environment to produce.

That's important because playoff defenses are designed to take away what teams do best. If an opponent tries to eliminate the Thunder's transition game, Oklahoma City can execute in the half court. If defenses collapse on Gilgeous-Alexander, the Thunder have capable shooters and playmakers around him. And if the game comes down to the final five minutes, OKC has a superstar who can manufacture offense.

Chet Holmgren could determine the ceiling

The biggest question surrounding the Thunder isn't talent. It's health. Chet Holmgren's availability is one of the most important storylines entering camp. When healthy, Holmgren gives Oklahoma City a unique two-way weapon. His length changes the geometry of the floor on both ends, while his ability to stretch defenses creates additional room for Gilgeous-Alexander.

Defensively, he can protect the rim without forcing the Thunder to sacrifice mobility. That combination matters enormously in the playoffs. Against a traditional big, Holmgren can pull the opposing center away from the basket. Against a smaller lineup, his size can become a major advantage around the rim.

The Thunder don't need him to carry the offense. They need him to be healthy and consistently available. If that happens, Oklahoma City's best lineup becomes extremely difficult to match.

The Thunder can win in different ways

Championship teams rarely survive four playoff rounds by playing only one style. Oklahoma City has enough versatility to win games in several ways. The Thunder can play fast. They can attack mismatches. They can create turnovers and turn defense into offense. They can space the floor around Gilgeous-Alexander. And they have enough length to make life difficult for opposing scorers.

That becomes particularly important when considering potential opponents from the Eastern Conference . A series against a bigger, more physical team would present different challenges than a matchup against a perimeter-oriented Western Conference opponent.

But Oklahoma City's roster construction gives it options. The Thunder aren't dependent on one matchup or one offensive concept. Being the preseason No. 1 team doesn't mean Oklahoma City has a clear path to another championship.

The Spurs might have something to say about that. San Antonio , fresh off a championship run behind Wembanyama, enters the season with arguably the highest ceiling in the league. The fact that some rankings have flipped the Spurs and Thunder entirely demonstrates how little separation there may be between the two teams.

Wembanyama represents perhaps the most difficult individual matchup in basketball because of his combination of size, skill and defensive range. The Thunder already know how difficult San Antonio can be after their seven-game postseason battle. That experience could ultimately help them.
